thread:
Anita P.: FYI found a reliable mismatch when bringing up magnet32k quant4-v2 with anchored-prefill. FP32 and INT4 match until ~pos 12288 then diverge.

Matt R.: power-of-two boundary? that's a red flag. Is this RoPE or kv merge?

Anita P.: looks RoPE-related; multiplier matrix diffs spike locally near the anchor boundary. Run command below.

Jasmin: paste run command & prompt please.

Anita P.: run:
```
./ci/onboard_eval.sh \
  --model=magnet32k:fp32   # baseline
  --model=magnet32k:int4   # qpt_int4_v2
  --anchor=anchored-prefill \
  --prompt=tests/long/8_passages_plus_q.txt \
  --max_tokens=16384 \
  --seed=2026 \
  --debug=rotary,kv
```
Prompt = 8 long passages (~1.6k tokens each) + a final question.

Leo: int4 kernel path?

Anita P.: dynfused_int4_prefill, per-channel scales, folded zero_point.

Dev-Bot: note: magnet32k:int4 running on dev-dedicated-6 ident dynfused_int4_prefill#0x2b.

Jasmin: logs show kv_hit parity until pos ~12288. Then prefix_mismatch_count jumps and avg_logprob_delta climbs to ~0.8-1.0.

Jasmin: snippet:
[2026-03-22T11:21:10Z] prefetched_prefix_len=12256 kv_hit_rate=0.994
[2026-03-22T11:21:11Z] prefetched_prefix_len=12288 prefix_mismatch_count=0
[2026-03-22T11:45:02Z] prefetched_prefix_len=12320 prefix_mismatch_count=29 avg_logprob_delta=0.86

Matt R.: isolator results?

Jasmin: ran rotary multiplier isolator pos 12180..12350 comparing FP32 vs quantized codegen.
Result:
pos_start=12180 pos_end=12350
max_abs_diff=2.5e-3 at pos=12288
mean_abs_diff=4.6e-4

Anita P.: attention scores differ after KV merge at same window. Small changes flip some top tokens.

SRE-Bot: perf note: int4 reduces GPU mem ~34% and median token latency +7% for these long runs; tail OK.

Matt R.: hypotheses:
- index truncation/overflow in quant kernel's rotary compute (pos-id arithmetic)
- quant math truncation combined with anchored-prefill stride creates local aliasing

Action plan:
1) repro on dynfused_int8
2) run jittered anchors (offsets -8..+8) to test sensitivity
3) build kernel variant toggling pos-index width to int64 for rotary compute and run canary
4) add an onboarding unit test comparing multiplier mats to 40k positions (warn/fail thresholds)

Leo: I'll patch a kernel toggle for int64 pos-index and run overnight canary. If spike disappears, that's a smoking gun.

Jasmin: I'll implement the unit test and add a CI gating step for rescaled-RoPE models.

Anita P.: I'll run jitter + int8 contrast today and upload artifacts to gs://redwood-internal/rotary-debug/3198765432/. Will post results here.

Matt R.: if kernel change is needed we'll consider targeted workaround: use higher-precision pos-index path for rescaled-rope models or clamp phase multiplers near tile boundaries.

Anita P.: thanks all. tagging eng-runtime and perf on the canary. :thumbsup:
